newsitem.title: UK: UK's Keller says takes over Maker Hldgs.
newsitem.headline: UK's Keller says takes over Maker Hldgs.

text.p: British construction engineering firm Keller Group Plc said on Tuesday it had acquired Makers Holdings, a concrete repair and structural restoration contractor. Keller said it was paying Makers an initial consideration of 5.8 milliion stg, with 1.8 million stg payable in cash and 4.0 million stg in loan notes. A deferred consideration of up to a maximum of 2.3 million stg is payable in loan notes depending on the level of profits achieved by Makers in the period to December 31, 1999.

Makers reported pretax profits of 1.2 million stg on sales of 16.9 million during the year to January 31, 1996. Keller said Makers had net assets of 1.1 million stg with its business operating from offices in Cambridgeshire, Staffordshire and Cheshire. "The acquisition of Makers represents a significant strengthening of Keller's position in the concrete repair market and provides Keller with access to the wider building restoration market," Keller said in its statement. --London Newsroom +44-171-542 7717
